metadata.question: Did nighttime light intensity across Puerto Rico decline between September 21, 2016, and September 22, 2016?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare nighttime lights between two consecutive days in September 2016 - Use VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band (DNB) - the standard nighttime light product - Collection: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG" (monthly) won't work for daily comparison - Need daily product: "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/DAILY_V1/VIIRS_DNB_DAILY" or similar - Actually, VIIRS daily data might not be available in GEE for 2016 - Let me use "NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2" which is daily VIIRS nighttime product available from 2012 2. Masking strategy: - For nighttime lights, we want actual light measurements - Should filter for quality flags but not mask clouds in the traditional sense - Focus on the DNB radiance values 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid zero or low values ARE meaningful for nighttime lights (power outage = decline) - If we get valid numbers for both dates, compare them: decline = A, no decline = B - If no images exist for either date: C1 - If images exist but no valid pixels after quality filtering: C2 - If calculation returns None/NaN: C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Puerto Rico geometry const puertoRico = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-67.3, 17.9, -65.2, 18.5]); // Define dates const date1 = '2016-09-21'; const date2 = '2016-09-22'; console.log("Analyzing nighttime lights for Puerto Rico..."); // Try VNP46A2 - VIIRS Daily Gridded Day Night Band let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2') .filterBounds(puertoRico) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A2') .filterBounds(puertoRico) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Sept 21 images: ${size1}`); console.log(`Sept 22 images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("No daily VIIRS data found. Trying monthly composite..."); // Fallback to monthly data - get September 2016 const monthly = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterBounds(puertoRico) .filterDate('2016-09-01', '2016-09-30'); const monthlySize = await monthly.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Monthly images: ${monthlySize}`); if (monthlySize === 0) { console.log("No data available for September 2016."); console.log("C1"); return; } console.log("Cannot assess daily change with monthly data."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get images const img1 = ee.Image(col1.first()); const img2 = ee.Image(col2.first()); // Use DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL band (BRDF-corrected nighttime lights) const band = 'DNB_BRDF-Corrected_NTL'; // Calculate mean nighttime light intensity with pixel count const stats1 = await img1.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: puertoRico, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await img2.select(band).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: puertoRico, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).getInfo(); const mean1 = stats1[band + '_mean']; const count1 = stats1[band + '_count']; const mean2 = stats2[band + '_mean']; const count2 = stats2[band + '_count']; console.log(`Sept 21: Mean=${mean1}, Pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Sept 22: Mean=${mean2}, Pixels=${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean1 == null || mean2 == null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log("Calculation returned invalid values."); console.log("C3"); return; } const decline = mean2 < mean1; const percentChange = ((mean2 - mean1) / mean1 * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`Change: ${percentChange}% (${decline ? 'Decline' : 'Increase/Stable'})`); if (decline) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
